'''Brian Harford''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2001 Carmel tournament]] on 30 May 2001 with DS Podrace deck, according to Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2397">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-31-carmel-in-5-30-01d2397/ carmel-in-5-30-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 31 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-31-carmel-in-5-30-01d2397/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
